newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bhakti to up stake in Ficorinvest.
newsitem.headline: Bhakti to up stake in Ficorinvest.

text.p: Indonesia's privately-owned firm PT Bhakti Investama said on Monday it planned to increase its stake in small-sized bank PT Bank Ficorinvest to 26 percent from 19.41 percent.

"The firm (Bhakti Investama) plans to own up to 26 percent stake in target firm (Bank Ficorinvest) so that it needs (to buy) 10,544,000 shares, or 6.59 percent stake," Bhakti Investama said in a statement.
Bhakti said it planned to buy the additional stake from the public at 2,050 rupiah per share.
The statement did not give further details.
